notes: Malaysian vocabulary, not Indonesian: kedai, tetapan, kemas kini, percuma, akaun, telefon, pelayan, muat turun.
The player is kamu in the game and in chat; the web and legal pages use anda.
Plurals use only other (Malay has no plural categories); no reduplication after a number ({n} pahlawan).
Malay has no grammatical gender and dia is neutral, so nothing agrees with {name} or the player.
Generated names are noun-first with a space (generatedNames should be noun-first): Puncak + Guruh = Puncak Guruh, Pedang + Kembar = Pedang Kembar.
Malay uses only Latin-1 letters, so the bundled Latin fonts are enough.
Japan statutory pages are translated fully into Malay; the support page links them by their Japanese titles.
ui.your_purchase_been_delivered + ui.s_have are a fragment pair: Malay builds the plural by reduplication (Pembelian{arg1} kamu → Pembelian-pembelian kamu).
This translation has not been reviewed by a native Malay speaker.
